title: Nitinol (NiTi)
description: Documented public shape-memory alloy (Naval Ordnance Laboratory (Buehler, 1960s)) for the Smart Material Simulator capability area.
body:
Nitinol (NiTi) is a documented shape-memory alloy from Naval Ordnance Laboratory (Buehler, 1960s). Nickel-titanium shape-memory alloy that recovers programmed shapes on heating; the basis of stents, actuators, and morphing structures.

How it works: It works by evaluating sigma = E * alpha * delta-T for the fully constrained case, the standard first estimate of thermal stress.

Documented uses of this capability area include alloy design for aerospace, metamaterial antennas and cloaks, composite airframes, and failure-life prediction for critical structures.
